module: Facade of the drag system for flowgraph nodes (missions) and the Vue interface. It contains almost no logic: it forwards to gameplay_drag_core, saveSystem, rulesMenu, timeslip and phaseHandlers, provides ready-to-use data for the UI (race info, dial, tree state, live times, track rules) and pushes guihooks (dragRaceInfoChanged, dragDialDataChanged, onDragRaceLiveTimesData, onDragReset) when the drag state changes. A modder uses it to start/stop a race, set drivers and dials, or generate opponents.
usage:
gameplay_drag_dragBridge.loadDragDataForMission('/levels/west_coast_usa/dragstrips/strip.dragSettings.json')
gameplay_drag_dragBridge.setVehicles({{id = playerId, lane = 1, isPlayable = true, dial = 11.5}})
gameplay_drag_dragBridge.startDragRaceActivity(1)
notes: startDragRace always returns a truthy value: the expression is "startDragRaceActivity(...) or true", so even a failed start returns true (only the absence of a vehicle returns false).
startDragRace ignores the vehicleId parameter for the start (it is only used to check that the vehicle exists): core.startDragRaceActivity(lane or 1) is called without a vehicle.
Speed times (type 'velocity') are in m/s; the UI receives value_kmh and value_mph (strings with 3 decimals).
The phase messages of the HUD info (Staging, On Tree, Racing, Stopping, Ready) are hardcoded in English.
onUpdate sends to the UI only the timers whose value changed by more than 0.0005 s (per-lane cache, emptied on every setup/reset/clear).
getTimers/getRacerData return {} when nothing is found (whereas core.getRacerData returns nil).

applyRulesRestore.desc: Returns the saved rules of a track (delegates to rulesMenu.applyRulesRestore).

returns.desc: Rules, nil if rulesMenu is absent.

applyRulesSave.desc: Saves the rules of a track (rulesMenu). In MP, broadcasts them to the clients (broadcastRulesUpdate); also applies importantTimerId, dragType and treeType to the current race data.

cleanup.desc: Stops the race if it is started (stopDragRace).

clearRacers.desc: Removes all racers from the current data (core.reset with clearRacers = true).

clearTimeslip.desc: Clears the slip on the UI side (core.reset with timeslip = true).

closeMenu.desc: Closes all career menus (career_career.closeAllMenus). Also serves as the tether callback.

configureDragStrip.desc: Compatibility: returns true if dragStrip is not nil. The actual config is applied by core.setDragRaceData.

generateHashFromFile.desc: Identification hash of a vehicle/config for the dial book (saveSystem.generateHashFromFile). Without argument, uses player 0's vehicle.

generateOpponentsGroup.desc: Builds a list of opponents (model, config, paint) whose time_1_4 time (Performance Data or Drag Times) is in [dial - offset; dial + 0.4[ and that respect the vehicle permission rules. If none is eligible, falls back to the player's vehicle. Excludes simple_traffic configs.

vehId.desc: Identifier used for core_vehicles.getVehicleDetails (model/config name of the player's vehicle, inferred from code).

dial.desc: Target time (s); default time_1_4 of the vehicle, otherwise 10.

vehiclePermissionRules.desc: Rules {path = {keys...}, allowedValues = {...}} or {path, value} tested on the model.

returns.desc: List {model, config, paint}, nil if invalid input or no time data.

getActiveRacerId.desc: Vehicle ID of the first playable racer.

getDialTimes.desc: Book of the saved dial times (saveSystem.getDialTimes), keyed by vehicle hash.

getDragDialData.desc: Dial data of the local playable racer: vehicleId, dialValue (10 by default), isSet, importantTimerId, importantTimerLabel, isBracketRace.

getDragInfoData.desc: All the data of the drag info HUD widget: dragType, stripName, treeType and label, important timer, dial, isStarted/isCompleted, current phase, list of racers (name, lane, phase, dial, finished, DQ), and in MP the current round, the number of rounds and the waiting list.

returns.desc: Data, nil if no track is loaded.

getDragIsStarted.desc: True if the race is started.

getDragRaceData.desc: Data of the playable racer: vehicleId, lane, timers, isFinished, isDisqualified, disqualificationReason, currentPhase, damage, phases.

getDragRaceRuntimeData.desc: Runtime data of the playable racer: phase, isStarted, isCompleted, timers, phases, DQ, damage, vehiclePosition (vehPos), vehicleSpeed (vehSpeed).

getDragStripInfo.desc: Info of a track: stripName, dragType, context, lanes, phases, prefabs, canBeTeleported, canBeReseted. Loads the track by id (saveSystem.loadCompleteDragRaceData) or uses the current data.

getPlayerRaceResult.desc: Player's result from generateWinData: playerWin, playerPos, winners, dialDiff (player's time minus their dial) and threshold (time of the best non-disqualified opponent minus the player's).

getRacerData.desc: Full racer table of a vehicle.

getRulesScreenData.desc: Data of the Vue rules screen (delegates to rulesMenu.getRulesScreenData).

returns.desc: Data, nil if rulesMenu is absent.

getStripLaneInfo.desc: Lane info of the first track of the current level: lanes list (index, longName, shortName, color), timers (or DEFAULT_TIMERS) and importantTimerId.

getTreeLightUIState.desc: Tree state for the UI, on the lane side of the playable racer: isStaging, stageLights (prestageLight, stageLight), countDownLights (amberLight1..3, greenLight, redLight), globalLights.blueLight.

isDragRaceActive.desc: True if a race is started (countdown or in progress).

loadDragDataForMission.desc: Loads the track data from a file via core.loadDragDataForMission; logs an error on failure.

loadDragStrip.desc: Loads a track by id: tries saveSystem.loadCompleteDragRaceData then loadDragStripData.

onDragClear.desc: Hook: when drag is cleared, sends nil to the guihooks dragRaceInfoChanged/dragDialDataChanged and hides the topLeft apps dragInfo and dragDialControl.

onDragDataSet.desc: Hook: track armed; pushes info and dial to the UI and shows the topLeft app dragInfo.

onDragRaceListChanged.desc: MP hook: the race list changes; pushes dragRaceInfoChanged.

onDragRacePlayersUpdated.desc: MP hook: players updated; pushes dragRaceInfoChanged.

onDragRaceStarted.desc: MP hook: round started; empties the live times cache and pushes dragRaceInfoChanged.

onDragRaceStateChanged.desc: MP hook: the race state changes; pushes dragRaceInfoChanged.

onDragRacersSetup.desc: Hook emitted by core.startDragRaceActivity: empties the times cache and pushes info and dial to the UI.

onDragReset.desc: Reset hook: empties the times cache, pushes info and dial to the UI and triggers the guihook onDragReset.

onMenuClosed.desc: Hook: a menu is closed; removes the facility's proximity tether.

onRacerPhaseTransition.desc: Hook emitted by phaseHandlers on a racer's phase change; refreshes the HUD info.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: sends to the UI (onDragRaceLiveTimesData) the new or modified timer values of each lane, local or received from the network.

openHistoryScreen.desc: Opens the drag history screen (route mission.dragHistory); in career, places a 4 m spherical tether near the facility's door.

openRulesScreen.desc: Opens the Vue screen of drag rules and settings (route mission.dragRules) for a facility; 4 m tether in career.

openRulesScreenForStrip.desc: Opens the rules screen for a given track (e.g. from the MP gamemode UI).

reset.desc: Resets the race. Without argument: full reset (raceState, racers, timeslip, transitionLock, treeLightStaging, hooks); otherwise passes opts to core.reset.

returns.desc: false if no drag data, otherwise true.

screenshotTimeslip.desc: Takes a screenshot of the slip (gameplay_drag_timeslip.screenshotTimeslip).

setLocalPlayerDial.desc: Sets the dial of the local playable racer then refreshes the HUD info.

returns.desc: true if at least one applied.

setVehicles.desc: Creates several racers at once and sets isPlayable and the dial (if > 0).

showDialControl.desc: Shows the dial setting app (dragDialControl) in the topLeft container.

startDragRace.desc: Starts a race (core.startDragRaceActivity(lane or 1)) after checking that a valid vehicle exists.

returns.desc: false if no vehicle, otherwise always true (see notes).

stopDragRace.desc: Stops the race: full clear (hooks, transitionLock, localRace, extensions, data, context, ui, treeLightStaging).

unloadRace.desc: Same full clear as stopDragRace, with no return value.
